body.name: Alg
body.sig: \(\mathsf A(\mathfrak R)=(q^+,\mathcal E_n,\mathfrak C)\in\mathbb Q\times\mathbb Q_+^6\times\mathsf{Cert}\)
body.def: From the effective record \(\mathfrak R\), perform at most \(w_{\max}\) best-first rational subdivisions of the temperature, local-contrast, covariance, and truncated Gaussian boxes. Evaluate \(G\), the Gaussian density, and every elementary transcendental with outward directed rounding; accept a refined value only when its rational lower-CDF sum verifies the target. Otherwise output the rational analytic fallback \(q^+=2B_\gamma^++(B_\gamma^+)^2/2\), whose certificate uses \(S(h,z)\le2\|z\|_\infty+\|z\|_\infty^2/2\) and the union Gaussian-tail bound.
